summary.en: Pools many ModelScope API keys into one OpenAI-compatible gateway and silently rotates to the next key on rate limits, exhausted quota or missing permissions. The model never changes; the UI follows the system language and shows quota usage.
summary.zh: 把多个魔搭 API Key 聚合成一个 OpenAI 兼容网关：遇限流、额度不足或无权限时自动无感换下一个 Key，模型始终不变。界面跟随系统语言，含额度与用量视图。
